title: BPW-2026-0474
text:
[BUREAU OF STREET SERVICES]
BPW-2026-0474
CD ALL
PROPOSED REVISIONS – STREET TREE REMOVAL PERMIT NOTIFICATION AND REPORTING POLICIES
Recommending that the Board review, approve, and adopt the following modifications to street tree removal notification and reporting policies (Policy 773):
REQUIRE the public be notified of the proposed removal of six or more street trees by: placing a public notice for a minimum period of 10 calendar days on each proposed tree removal providing the reason for tree removal and the Bureau of Street Services contact information, placement of the address/project on the Bureau of Street Services website;
REQUIRE a Board public hearing for the consideration of the removal of six or more street trees at a specific address or a single project containing multiple addresses;
EXEMPT trees measuring less than two inches in trunk diameter at standard height and exempt dead, dying, decayed trees or trees in poor or critical condition from the public notice and Board hearing requirement; and
EXEMPT trees cited in a liability claim against the City for accidents caused by sidewalk or roadway uplift or traffic visibility impairment and the Urban Forestry Division has determined they cannot be preserved.
summary: Adopt revisions to street tree removal permit notification and reporting policies.

flag.reason: Would weaken public notice for street-tree removals citywide; continued, date TBD.
